description: Family offices actively writing startup checks. Seeded with the eight most active offices named in The Founders Corner's Q3 2026 report, each checked against public sources.

seed_source.title: The Investors Who Are Actually Writing Checks In Q3
seed_source.author: Chris Tottman

field_guide.type: single_family_office = one family's own money; multi_family_office = manages money for several families; investment_entity = a principal's personal investing vehicle; unverified = name not confirmed in public sources
field_guide.verification: verified = identity and principal confirmed by two or more independent public sources; partial = identity confirmed but some fields thinly sourced; unverified = could not confirm the entity exists under this name
field_guide.q3_2026_deal_count: Publicly reported Q3 2026 deals as counted by the seed article. A floor, since many offices do not announce deals.
field_guide.null values: A null field means no reliable public source was found. It does not mean the answer is no.

offices.name: a16z Perennial
offices.wealth_source: Venture capital firm wealth-management arm serving founders and investors already in the a16z network
focus: private equity access via outside managers
offices.founder_note: Serves people already partnered with a16z, so it is a warm-intro-only target.

offices.name: YZi Labs
offices.q3_2026_deal_count_note: Seed article counts 10 transactions in August 2026 alone, mostly early stage.
offices.founder_note: Formerly Binance Labs. Renamed and converted to a family office on 2025-01-23, managing about $10B. Founded year refers to Binance Labs.

offices.name: Bezos Expeditions
offices.founder_note: Invests only the principal's capital. Past holdings include Airbnb, Uber, Twitter, Workday, and Anduril.

offices.name: ICONIQ
principals: Clients reported to include Mark Zuckerberg, Sheryl Sandberg, Jack Dorsey, Reid Hoffman
offices.founder_note: Reported AUM ranges from about $54B (Bloomberg, 2021) to $117.5B (SEC Form ADV, per a directory profile). Past bets include Snowflake, Epic Games, and Robinhood.

offices.name: Duquesne Family Office
offices.wealth_source: Hedge fund manager, Duquesne Capital Management
offices.founder_note: Set up in 2010 after Druckenmiller closed his hedge fund. Joined the $257M Cellares Series D in January 2026. Venture portfolio is thinly documented in public sources.

offices.name: Doerr Capital
offices.founder_note: The seed article names this office, but no public source confirms an entity called Doerr Capital. The Antora press release lists John Doerr personally as an investor. His confirmed investing vehicle is Foris Ventures, listed separately. This record may be a duplicate of Foris Ventures and should be merged if so.

offices.name: Thiel Capital
offices.wealth_source: PayPal co-founder, Palantir co-founder, early Facebook investor
offices.founder_note: Opened a Miami office in December 2025. Separate from Founders Fund, which Thiel co-founded. Etched round reports conflict and name Thiel personally, so confirm the investing entity before citing it.

offices.name: Foris Ventures
offices.founder_note: Described as John Doerr's private venture firm and family office. Backed Panthalassa, Pacific Fusion, Rondo Energy, Complete Solaria ($10M, 2023), and led Tradesy's $67M Series D.
